channel.title: Conservatory of Recording Arts and Sciences - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Conservatory of Recording Arts and Sciences (audiorecordingschool.com)

item.title: ADA Policy
item.description: Learn how audio recording schools provide ADA accommodations and support for students with disabilities — including accessible studios, testing, and classroom environments.

item.title: Awards
item.description: See how audio school alumni have won Grammys, Emmys, and other industry awards. Discover why recognition matters — and how it proves a school’s impact in real careers.

item.title: Grants and Loans
item.description: Learn how to pay for audio recording school with grants, student loans, FAFSA, and scholarships. Get financial aid tips and discover what funding you may qualify for.

item.title: Financial Aid Code
item.description: Learn how to use your audio school’s FAFSA code to apply for grants and loans. Find financial aid codes and tips for submitting your FAFSA the right way.

item.title: Studios
item.description: Explore the professional studios at audio recording school — from tracking rooms to mixing suites. Get hands-on training with the gear the pros use every day.

item.title: Live Sound Venue
item.description: Train in a real live sound venue at audio recording school. Learn FOH mixing, monitor setup, stage audio, and event production in a hands-on performance space.

item.title: Labs
item.description: Discover how audio school labs help you learn by doing — with real gear, guided practice, and open studio time that builds your skills and confidence.

item.title: AES Chapter
item.description: Learn how an AES student chapter helps audio students connect with the industry. Discover events, competitions, networking, and opportunities to grow your career.

item.title: Broadcast Audio
item.description: Learn what audio recording school teaches about broadcast audio — from real-time mixing and signal flow to live-streaming, crew communication, and TV-ready sound.

item.title: Podcast Production
item.description: Discover what audio recording school teaches about podcast production — from capturing clean audio and editing to voice processing, storytelling, and remote recording.
